text:
You can make both changes yourself in "Account" > "Subscriptions". Because today is the 20th, anything you change before the 25th applies to your next box.

- **Starter to Collector:** Collector is $49/month (a medium or rare plant in a 6-inch pot), versus $29/month for Starter.
- **Pause:** The maximum pause is 3 months, so I can't set up a 4-month pause. You can pause for 3 months before the 25th. Our policy doesn't say whether a pause can be extended or renewed afterward, so I can escalate to a Support Lead if you want to ask about that.

I'm also not sure how the plan change and pause work together, such as which plan applies when you resume, so I can include that in the escalation if you'd like.
